name: How Apartment Move-In Specials Work in 2026 and Where to Find Them
seo-title: Apartment Move-In Specials 2026: Find Deals | brightplace
meta-description: Move-in specials can cut your upfront rental costs by $500 to $2,000. Here is what they include, when they are most common, and how to find them near you.
post-summary: A move-in special is a temporary incentive from a landlord or property manager that reduces your upfront or ongoing lease cost, typically saving renters $500 to $2,000 (as of Q3 2026). Moving specials for apartments include free rent months, waived deposits, reduced fees, and flat-rate total move-in
